mapper.select: select b.name as institutionName, tydm as unifiedSocialCreditCode, fddbr as legalPerson, c.itemname as licenseDeviceName, f.itemname as ownershipNature, d.itemname as ladderConfigModel, e.fullname as equipmentConfigAddress, sbpzdz as detailedAddress, fzjg as issuingAuthority, fzrq as issueDate from history_license a LEFT JOIN history_dept b ON a.pzdwmc = b.duns LEFT JOIN history_dict c ON a.xksbmc = c.dictid AND a.xksbmc IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN history_dict d ON a.jtpzjx = d.dictid AND a.jtpzjx IS NOT NULL left join history_dict f on a.syzxz = f.dictid and a.syzxz is not null left join history_area e on a.sbpzdzCode = e.id where a.id = #{id} GROUP BY a.id

select scqy as productionEnterprise, jtxh as specificModel, sn as productSerialNo, zjrq as installationDate, bsrq as infoSubmitDate, fzjg_f as duplicateIssuingAuthority, fzrq_f as duplicateIssueDate, memo as remark from history_license where id = #{id}
